scene: Inferno XXII — Ciampolo tricks Malebranche; Alichino and Calcabrina fall into pitch
story: Dante and Virgil travel beside the boiling pitch under the Malebranche escort, hearing the demons' grotesque signals and seeing occasional backs rise briefly above the surface.
A demon hooks a barrator from Navarre, commonly called Ciampolo, and pulls him out of the tar.
Under questioning, Ciampolo identifies other barrators and offers to summon more if the demons stand back and hide.
The demons entertain his proposal; Alichino boasts that he can intercept him if he tries to dive.
Ciampolo exploits their distraction and leaps back into the pitch, escaping Alichino's grasp.
Calcabrina attacks Alichino in anger, and the two demons fight, fall into the boiling pitch and become trapped.
Other demons rush to retrieve them. Dante and Virgil continue toward the next bolgia; trust in the escort is further undermined.

semanticSomatic.semantic: A captive can exploit a watcher's expectations and their limited view

somatic.gesture: offers to call companions, gains space, then plunges into the pitch
somatic.observable: he disappears beneath the surface before the demons can seize him

semanticSomatic.semantic: Confidence in interception does not guarantee capture

somatic.gesture: promises to catch Ciampolo, pursues him but fails, then fights Calcabrina and falls into the pitch
somatic.observable: the boast is contradicted by the failed interception

semanticSomatic.semantic: Attention diverted from the original target can create a second failure

somatic.gesture: confronts Alichino; both tumble into the pitch
somatic.observable: the two watchers become trapped in the medium they were patrolling

semanticSomatic.semantic: A guard group can lose its ability to maintain surveillance through conflict within the group

somatic.gesture: surrounds the captive then rushes to rescue the fallen demons
somatic.observable: watcher actions shift from barrator to demon retrieval

semanticSomatic.semantic: Preserve the difference between a promise, a failed capture and an observed escape

somatic.gesture: observe the trick, escape and collision, then keep moving
somatic.observable: reported intention does not overwrite the outcome

cipher.operator: CAPTURE -> PROMISE -> DIVERT -> DIVE -> MISS -> GRAPPLE -> FALL
invariants: A promised interception must not be recorded as an accomplished capture
The observer's response can be manipulated when attention is redirected
An observed escape into opacity is not proof of physical disappearance or destruction
Conflict among watchers can disrupt the observation process
Alichino and Calcabrina fall into pitch; this does not establish that the entire escort is gone

witnesses.somatic: CIAMPOLO OFFERS to summon others and DIVERTS the demons
witnesses.observable: a conditional promise draws the guards' attention
escape is observed rather than recorded as capture

witnesses.somatic: CALCABRINA ATTACKS ALICHINO; both FALL into pitch
witnesses.observable: two demons become temporarily trapped; other demons attempt rescue
